answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and reported only in the primary region, which matches the March latency incident where failover shifted traffic cleanly and recovered in minutes (memory_b2). The release two hours ago is a real competing cause (memory_b1), so both archives should be checked before lock-in. Circuit breakers are rejected: failing the payments/settlement dependency would drop customer writes and violate the objective (memory_b4). Read-replica routing treated dashboard reads, not this write path (memory_b5). Capacity-add is a weaker fit mid-peak than a region shift already shown to restore write latency. Failover during daily settlement peak still carries downstream settlement/consistency risk, which is flagged. Until the two records are verified, treat the regional diagnosis as leading not proven.
